<style>:root{--fjb-font:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;--fjb-accent:#ff69b4;--fjb-deep:#ff1493;--fjb-user-text:#5a3a4a;--fjb-task-main:#ff8c00;--fjb-task-side:#3498db;--fjb-task-daily:#27ae60;--fjb-task-hidden:#9b59b6;--fjb-event-high:#e74c3c;--fjb-event-mid:#f39c12;--fjb-event-low:#95a5a6;--fjb-q-common:#95a5a6;--fjb-q-fine:#3498db;--fjb-q-rare:#9b59b6;--fjb-q-epic:#ff8c00;--fjb-q-legend:#f1c40f;--fjb-done:#27ae60;--fjb-done-deep:#1e7e34;--fjb-rel-acquaint:#2980b9;--fjb-rel-trust:#27ae60;--fjb-ending-purple:#800080}
/* ===== 美化组件 · 技能提升卡片 ===== */
.fjb-skillup{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  margin:10px 0;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,240,245,.95),rgba(255,228,236,.88));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,.3);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(255,105,180,.18);
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);overflow:hidden;
  animation:fjbSkillUpSlide .4s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbSkillUpSlide{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.fjb-skillup-icon{
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff69b4,#ff1493);
  color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,105,180,.4);
}
.fjb-skillup-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.fjb-skillup-title{font-size:12px;color:var(--fjb-accent);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:2px}
.fjb-skillup-delta{font-size:16px;color:var(--fjb-deep);font-weight:700}
.fjb-skillup-delta strong{font-size:18px}
.fjb-skillup-tier{font-size:11px;color:rgba(122,85,96,.65);margin-top:2px}
.fjb-skillup-glow{
  position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:80px;height:100%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 80% 50%,rgba(255,105,180,.15),transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 阶段晋升卡片 ===== */
.fjb-stageup{
  margin:12px 0;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);
  box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(128,0,128,.2);
  animation:fjbStageUpSlide .5s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbStageUpSlide{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.fjb-stageup-banner{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#667eea,#764ba2,#667eea);
  color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:6px 12px;
  font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;
}
.fjb-stageup-arrow{display:inline-block;margin:0 8px;opacity:.7}
.fjb-stageup-body{
  padding:14px 18px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(102,126,234,.08),rgba(118,75,162,.08));
  border:1px solid rgba(118,75,162,.2);border-top:none;
}
.fjb-stageup-stage{font-size:15px;color:#5a3a7a;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
.fjb-stageup-stage strong{font-size:18px;color:#764ba2}
.fjb-stageup-name{font-size:18px;color:#5a3a7a;font-weight:700;margin:4px 0}
.fjb-stageup-desc{font-size:12px;color:rgba(90,58,122,.65);line-height:1.5}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 状态变化梅花提示 ===== */
.fjb-statchange{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  margin:4px 6px;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  vertical-align:middle;
  animation:fjbStatFade .3s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbStatFade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.fjb-statchange-icon{font-size:14px}
.fjb-statchange-type{color:inherit}
.fjb-statchange-delta{font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.fjb-statchange-reason{font-size:11px;opacity:.7;font-weight:400}
/* 正值（恢复/增加）- 绿色 */
.fjb-statchange[data-delta^="+"]{
  background:rgba(46,204,113,.12);border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,.3);color:#27ae60;
}
/* 负值（消耗/减少）- 红色 */
.fjb-statchange[data-delta^="-"]{
  background:rgba(231,76,60,.12);border:1px solid rgba(231,76,60,.3);color:#c0392b;
}
/* 无变化 - 灰色 */
.fjb-statchange:not([data-delta^="+"]):not([data-delta^="-"]){
  background:rgba(149,165,166,.12);border:1px solid rgba(149,165,166,.3);color:#7f8c8d;
}
/* icon 为空时显示默认图标 */
.fjb-statchange-icon:empty::before{content:"◆"}

/* ===== 扩展美化组件 · 主题变量扩展 ===== */
:root{
  /* 任务类型色 */
  --fjb-task-main:#ff8c00;       /* 主线 - 橙 */
  --fjb-task-side:#3498db;       /* 支线 - 蓝 */
  --fjb-task-daily:#27ae60;      /* 日常 - 绿 */
  --fjb-task-hidden:#9b59b6;     /* 隐藏 - 紫 */
  /* 事件重要度色 */
  --fjb-event-high:#e74c3c;      /* 高 - 红 */
  --fjb-event-mid:#f39c12;       /* 中 - 黄 */
  --fjb-event-low:#95a5a6;       /* 低 - 灰 */
  /* 物品品质色 */
  --fjb-q-common:#95a5a6;        /* 普通 - 灰 */
  --fjb-q-fine:#3498db;          /* 精良 - 蓝 */
  --fjb-q-rare:#9b59b6;          /* 稀有 - 紫 */
  --fjb-q-epic:#ff8c00;          /* 史诗 - 橙 */
  --fjb-q-legend:#f1c40f;        /* 传说 - 金 */
  /* 任务完成 - 绿 */
  --fjb-done:#27ae60;
  --fjb-done-deep:#1e7e34;
  /* 关系类型辅助色 */
  --fjb-rel-acquaint:#2980b9;    /* 熟稔 - 蓝 */
  --fjb-rel-trust:#27ae60;       /* 信任 - 绿 */
  /* 结局辅助色 */
  --fjb-ending-purple:#800080;
}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 购买补给卡片 ===== */
.fjb-purchase{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  margin:10px 0;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,240,245,.95),rgba(255,228,236,.88));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,.3);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(255,105,180,.18);
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);overflow:hidden;
  animation:fjbPurchaseSlide .4s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbPurchaseSlide{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-12px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
}
.fjb-purchase-icon{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:20px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-accent),var(--fjb-deep));
  color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,105,180,.4);
}
.fjb-purchase-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.fjb-purchase-title{
  font-size:13px;color:var(--fjb-deep);font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:6px;
}
.fjb-purchase-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:12px;margin:2px 0;
}
.fjb-purchase-label{
  display:inline-block;min-width:36px;
  padding:1px 6px;border-radius:6px;
  background:rgba(255,105,180,.12);
  color:var(--fjb-accent);font-weight:600;
}
.fjb-purchase-value{color:var(--fjb-user-text)}
.fjb-purchase-glow{
  position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:90px;height:100%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 80% 50%,rgba(255,105,180,.18),transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 任务接取卡片（type 决定左边界颜色） ===== */
.fjb-taskaccept{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  margin:14px 0 10px;padding:14px 16px 12px 18px;border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(255,240,245,.85));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,.25);
  border-left:4px solid var(--fjb-accent);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(255,105,180,.12);
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);
  animation:fjbTaskAcceptSlide .4s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbTaskAcceptSlide{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="主线"]{border-left-color:var(--fjb-task-main)}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="支线"]{border-left-color:var(--fjb-task-side)}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="日常"]{border-left-color:var(--fjb-task-daily)}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="隐藏"]{border-left-color:var(--fjb-task-hidden)}
.fjb-taskaccept-tag{
  position:absolute;top:-8px;left:14px;
  padding:1px 10px;border-radius:10px;
  background:var(--fjb-accent);color:#fff;
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;
}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="主线"] .fjb-taskaccept-tag{background:var(--fjb-task-main)}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="支线"] .fjb-taskaccept-tag{background:var(--fjb-task-side)}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="日常"] .fjb-taskaccept-tag{background:var(--fjb-task-daily)}
.fjb-taskaccept[data-type="隐藏"] .fjb-taskaccept-tag{background:var(--fjb-task-hidden)}
.fjb-taskaccept-body{flex:1;min-width:0;padding-top:2px}
.fjb-taskaccept-name{
  font-size:15px;color:var(--fjb-user-text);font-weight:700;
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.fjb-taskaccept-meta{
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;font-size:11px;
}
.fjb-taskaccept-difficulty{
  padding:1px 8px;border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(255,105,180,.12);color:var(--fjb-accent);
  font-weight:600;
}
.fjb-taskaccept-reward{color:rgba(122,85,96,.7)}
.fjb-taskaccept-icon{
  font-size:18px;color:var(--fjb-accent);
  animation:fjbTaskAcceptPulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes fjbTaskAcceptPulse{
  0%,100%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1)}
  50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.1)}
}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 任务完成卡片（绿色对勾） ===== */
.fjb-taskcomplete{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  margin:10px 0;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(232,245,233,.95),rgba(200,230,201,.85));
  border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,.35);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(46,204,113,.18);
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);overflow:hidden;
  animation:fjbTaskCompleteSlide .5s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbTaskCompleteSlide{
  from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.94)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
}
.fjb-taskcomplete-icon{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-done),#2ecc71);
  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(46,204,113,.4);
  animation:fjbTaskCompletePop .6s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbTaskCompletePop{
  0%{transform:scale(0)}
  60%{transform:scale(1.2)}
  100%{transform:scale(1)}
}
.fjb-taskcomplete-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.fjb-taskcomplete-title{
  font-size:14px;color:var(--fjb-done-deep);font-weight:700;
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.fjb-taskcomplete-reward{
  font-size:12px;color:var(--fjb-done);font-weight:600;
  margin-bottom:2px;
}
.fjb-taskcomplete-result{
  font-size:11px;color:rgba(30,126,52,.7);
  line-height:1.5;
}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 事件触发卡片（时间线风格） ===== */
.fjb-eventtrigger{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;
  margin:10px 0;padding:10px 14px 10px 12px;border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,240,245,.85),rgba(255,255,255,.7));
  border-left:3px solid var(--fjb-accent);
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);
  animation:fjbEventTriggerSlide .4s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbEventTriggerSlide{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-10px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
}
.fjb-eventtrigger-dot{
  width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  margin-top:6px;
  background:var(--fjb-accent);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,105,180,.2);
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="high"]{
  border-left-color:var(--fjb-event-high);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(253,235,236,.85),rgba(255,255,255,.7));
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="high"] .fjb-eventtrigger-dot{
  background:var(--fjb-event-high);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(231,76,60,.2);
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="mid"]{
  border-left-color:var(--fjb-event-mid);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,243,224,.85),rgba(255,255,255,.7));
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="mid"] .fjb-eventtrigger-dot{
  background:var(--fjb-event-mid);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(243,156,18,.2);
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="low"]{
  border-left-color:var(--fjb-event-low);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(236,239,241,.7),rgba(255,255,255,.6));
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="low"] .fjb-eventtrigger-dot{
  background:var(--fjb-event-low);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(149,165,166,.2);
}
.fjb-eventtrigger-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.fjb-eventtrigger-type{
  font-size:11px;color:var(--fjb-accent);font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:2px;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="high"] .fjb-eventtrigger-type{color:var(--fjb-event-high)}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="mid"] .fjb-eventtrigger-type{color:#d68910}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="low"] .fjb-eventtrigger-type{color:#7f8c8d}
.fjb-eventtrigger-desc{
  font-size:13px;color:var(--fjb-user-text);
  line-height:1.5;
}
.fjb-eventtrigger-importance{
  align-self:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
  padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(255,105,180,.12);color:var(--fjb-accent);
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="high"] .fjb-eventtrigger-importance{
  background:rgba(231,76,60,.12);color:var(--fjb-event-high);
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="mid"] .fjb-eventtrigger-importance{
  background:rgba(243,156,18,.12);color:#d68910;
}
.fjb-eventtrigger[data-importance="low"] .fjb-eventtrigger-importance{
  background:rgba(149,165,166,.12);color:#7f8c8d;
}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 物品获取卡片（品质色阶） ===== */
.fjb-itemget{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  margin:10px 0;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(255,240,245,.85));
  border:1px solid var(--fjb-accent);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(255,105,180,.15);
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);overflow:hidden;
  animation:fjbItemGetSlide .4s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbItemGetSlide{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
}
.fjb-itemget-icon{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:20px;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-q-common),#7f8c8d);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(149,165,166,.4);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="common"]{
  border-color:var(--fjb-q-common);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(149,165,166,.2);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="common"] .fjb-itemget-icon{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-q-common),#7f8c8d);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(149,165,166,.4);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="fine"]{
  border-color:var(--fjb-q-fine);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(52,152,219,.25);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="fine"] .fjb-itemget-icon{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-q-fine),#2980b9);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(52,152,219,.4);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="rare"]{
  border-color:var(--fjb-q-rare);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(155,89,182,.25);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="rare"] .fjb-itemget-icon{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-q-rare),#8e44ad);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(155,89,182,.4);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="epic"]{
  border-color:var(--fjb-q-epic);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(255,140,0,.25);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="epic"] .fjb-itemget-icon{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-q-epic),#e67e22);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,140,0,.4);
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="legend"]{
  border-color:var(--fjb-q-legend);
  box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(241,196,15,.35);
  animation:fjbItemGetSlide .4s ease,fjbItemGetLegend 2s ease-in-out .4s infinite;
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="legend"] .fjb-itemget-icon{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-q-legend),#f39c12);
  box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(241,196,15,.5);
}
@keyframes fjbItemGetLegend{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(241,196,15,.35)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(241,196,15,.55)}
}
.fjb-itemget-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.fjb-itemget-name{
  font-size:14px;color:var(--fjb-user-text);font-weight:700;
  margin-bottom:2px;
}
.fjb-itemget-quality{
  display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
  padding:1px 8px;border-radius:8px;
  margin-bottom:2px;letter-spacing:.5px;
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="common"] .fjb-itemget-quality{
  background:rgba(149,165,166,.15);color:#7f8c8d;
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="fine"] .fjb-itemget-quality{
  background:rgba(52,152,219,.15);color:#2980b9;
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="rare"] .fjb-itemget-quality{
  background:rgba(155,89,182,.15);color:#8e44ad;
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="epic"] .fjb-itemget-quality{
  background:rgba(255,140,0,.15);color:#e67e22;
}
.fjb-itemget[data-quality="legend"] .fjb-itemget-quality{
  background:rgba(241,196,15,.18);color:#d4ac0d;
}
.fjb-itemget-source{
  font-size:11px;color:rgba(122,85,96,.65);
}

/* ===== 美化组件 · 关系变化卡片（带头像占位） ===== */
.fjb-relchange{
  position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  margin:8px 0;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,240,245,.9),rgba(255,228,236,.8));
  border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,.25);
  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(255,105,180,.12);
  font-family:var(--fjb-font);
  animation:fjbRelChangeSlide .4s ease;
}
@keyframes fjbRelChangeSlide{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
}
.fjb-relchange-avatar{
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fjb-accent),var(--fjb-deep));
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,105,180,.35);
  overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;
}
.fjb-relchange-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.fjb-relchange-char{
  font-size:13px;color:var(--fjb-user-text);font-weight:700;
  margin-bottom:2px;
}
.fjb-relchange-info{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;
  margin-bottom:2px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.fjb-relchange-type{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;
  padding:1px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;
}
.fjb-relchange[data-type="好感"] .fjb-relchange-type{
  background:rgba(255,105,180,.15);color:var(--fjb-deep);
}
